subject: Clear the script debugger input buffer when it hits the size limit (#5129)
reason: The fix changes behaviour only at the Lua script debugger's buffer boundary: when the debugger input buffer ds.cbuf exceeds 1<<20 bytes it is now cleared (sdsfree + sdsempty) before the 'max client buffer reached' error returns, instead of returning with the oversized buffer still populated; the only observable effect is that a subsequent debugger REPL entry (after the error is caught by a Lua pcall) starts from a clean buffer rather than re-parsing >1MB of stale bytes. Triggering this requires sending more than 1,048,576 bytes of non-terminating data to the debugger socket in one accumulation
